response.text: {"summary":"The PRA Rulebook – Compliance and Internal Audit sets out the obligations for UK banks to establish, implement and maintain robust compliance and internal audit functions, covering regulated activities, MiFID-related services, ancillary and unregulated prudential activities. It applies to all UK banks (CRR firms) operating within the UK, requiring them to maintain independent compliance functions, risk-based monitoring, and regular reporting to management."}
